name: Visualization Authoring Tools
desc: We develop [languages](/research/#theme=tools&tag=language) and [systems](/research/#theme=tools&tag=system) to make it easy for anyone to create common and custom interactive visualizations.

name: Interpretability & Alignment
desc: We design [metrics](/pubs/shared-interest) and [interfaces](/pubs/knnviz) for [visually analyzing](/pubs/embedding-comparator/) ML models and for discovering how they [align with human expectations](/pubs/abstraction-alignment).

name: Accessible Data Representations
desc: [Working with blind collaborators](/pubs/sociotechnical-vis-access), we co-design non-visual data displays via [alt](/pubs/vis-text-model) [text](/pubs/vistext), [screen readers](/pubs/rich-screen-reader-vis-experiences), and [tactile graphics](/pubs/tactile-vega-lite).

name: Sociocultural Design
desc: We study how visualizations and ML models function as social artifacts: [signaling](/pubs/vibes/) [identities](/pubs/quantifying-vibes), [shaping norms](/pubs/cultural-interpretability), and [propagating misinformation](/pubs/viral-visualizations).

name: Cognitively Convivial Interaction
desc: We prototype [novel interaction paradigms](/pubs/towards-convivial-info-space) that fluidly mix [structures](/pubs/between-formal-informal) and [semantics](/pubs/semi-formal-design-space) to offer more [malleable experiences](/pubs/varv).
